KP 1. Determining Whether a p-Series with Integer Exponent Converges
1.?

Use the p-test to determine whether the series below converges or diverges. ∑n=1∞18n9

E
Wed, Jul 29th @ 5:39 PM|Elapsed: 0:11Correct

The series can be written as 18∑n=1∞1n9. This is a p-series with p=9. Since p>1, the series is convergent.

Note that the factor of 18 multiplying the series has no effect on the convergence/divergence of the series.

KP 3. Determining Which Series Converge From a List
5.?

Which of the following series are convergent?

  1. ∑n=1∞1nn3
  2. ∑n=1∞8n29
  3. ∑n=1∞n32n2
M
Wed, Jul 29th @ 5:43 PM|Elapsed: 1:14Correct

We analyze each series in turn.

  • First, we look at ∑n=1∞1nn3. Rewriting this gives ∑n=1∞1nn3=∑n=1∞1n⋅n3/2=∑n=1∞1n5/2, which is a p-series with p=52. Since p>1, the series converges by the p-series test.

  • For the second series, we have ∑n=1∞8n29=8⋅∑n=1∞1n2/9, which is a p-series with p=29. Since p≤1, the series is divergent.

  • For the third series, we have ∑n=1∞n32n2=12∑n=1∞n3/2n2=12∑n=1∞1n1/2, which is a p-series with p=12. Since p≤1, the series diverges by the p-series test.

Hence, the correct answer is "I only".

6.?

Which of the following series are convergent?

  1. ∑n=1∞14n
  2. ∑n=1∞1n2n
  3. ∑n=1∞23n5
M
Wed, Jul 29th @ 5:43 PM|Elapsed: 0:37Correct

We analyze each series in turn.

  • First, we look at ∑n=1∞14n. Rewriting this series gives ∑n=1∞14n=14⋅∑n=1∞1n, which is a p-series with p=1 (the harmonic series). Since p≤1, the series is divergent.

  • For the second series, we have ∑n=1∞1n2n=∑n=1∞1n2⋅n1/2=∑n=1∞1n5/2, and this is a p-series with p=52. Since p>1, the series converges by the p-series test.

  • For the third series, we have ∑n=1∞23n5=23⋅∑n=1∞1n5, and this is a p-series with p=5. Since p>1, the series converges by the p-series test.

Hence, the correct answer is "II and III only."

KP 4. Convergence Parameters for p-Series
7.?
For which values of q does the series ∑n=1∞1n−7−4q converge?
q
<
−2
M
Wed, Jul 29th @ 5:45 PM|Elapsed: 1:22Correct

A p-series is any series that takes the form ∑n=1∞1np,

where p is a constant. The p-series test states that

  • if p>1, then the series converges, while

  • if p≤1, then the series diverges.

Comparing our series to the p-series, we have

p=−7−4q.

According to the p-series test, the given series converges if

−7−4q>1⟹q<−2.

Therefore, the series is convergent for q<−2.

A p-series is any series that takes the form ∑n=1∞1np,

where p is a constant. The p-series test states that

  • if p>1, then the series converges, while

  • if p≤1, then the series diverges.

Comparing our series to the p-series, we have

p=2−3q.

According to the p-series test, the given series converges if

2−3q>1⟹q<13.

Therefore, the series is convergent for all q<13.
